shortDescription: China’s railway network carried 3.71 billion passenger trips in the first three quarters, a record for the period and up 4.8% from a year earlier, China State Railway Group Co. said on Sunday, according to Bloomberg.

title: China Railway Passenger Trips Reach Nine-Month Record of 3.71 Billion
